what: Tier 1 entry v2: 25 clips from the wave-2 entry, 5 replaced by the warm-start fine-tune.
selection: no-regression on all four metrics (tools/t1/adopt.py). Legal on Tier 1 only: the tier's input_note names the released trajectory as the configured scoring reference.

frame_references.why_mixed: the kit packer fits one rigid transform per episode from frame 0 of the recorded reference to frame 0 of the tree it is given, so a single tree would mis-convert whichever half of the entry it did not match. v2d frame-refs --assemble builds the per-clip tree and refuses an incomplete map.

seven_clips_still_training: e18 e06 e09 on v2d-t1f-2c; e23 e26 e29 on v2d-t1f-3c; all seven ship a final checkpoint, which is the group that gains. At the measured 5-of-8 adoption rate and +0.156 mean adopted gain, they project to about +0.023, i.e. ~0.514.
blocked_on: git push origin main. The CSV names commit/e8ffe8f, which resolves, but the warm-start code behind five of its rollouts is in unpushed commits (HEAD 4f70278).
